notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Elemental has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Quicksilver Elemental twice by paying {U}{U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of Incubation Druid and Pili-Pala until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.
